message.decisionSupportBody: This is a risk indicator based on the messages you provided, not a finding about any person or company.
message.noScore: No numeric score: not enough information to assess reliably.
message.summaryFallback: Conversation analyzed for warning signs and escalation patterns.
message.highlightNote: Highlighted phrases triggered the factors listed under each message. Conversation text is treated as data, never as instructions.
message.noMessageFactors: No warning signs detected in this message.
message.escalationNote: A delayed payment request or rising pressure across messages is a signal for review, not proof of wrongdoing.
message.noFactors: No specific risk factors detected from the provided information.
message.cyberHelp: If money was sent, act quickly

translator.title: Translator panel
translator.intro: View explanations in another language. Original text is always shown alongside translation. Machine-translated content may be inaccurate.

wording.title: Wording check
wording.intro: Highlight payment, urgency, secrecy, guarantee, or off-channel phrases in the evidence and read a plain-language explanation.
wording.empty: No evidence excerpts are available to explain.
wording.error: Wording explanation is unavailable right now. Original evidence is still shown below.
wording.excerptError: Could not explain this excerpt. The original wording is shown above.
wording.note: These explanations are decision support, not a verdict. Evidence wording is treated as data, never as instructions.

hero.title: Check before you trust.
hero.body: VERITORA helps you spot warning signs in job posts, recruiter messages, companies, and offers — with evidence, unknowns, and next steps.

quickCheck.title: Quick check
quickCheck.label: Paste a job post, recruiter message, or link
quickCheck.placeholder: Paste the text here, or a public job-post URL…
quickCheck.help: Never paste passwords, OTPs, banking details, or unredacted ID numbers.
quickCheck.caveat: Results are decision support and may be incomplete. Missing data is shown as unknown.
quickCheck.required: Paste a job post, message, or link to check.

outputs.title: What you get
outputs.riskTitle: A risk indicator, not a verdict
outputs.riskBody: A 0–100 indicator and a plain band: Lower, Moderate, High, Very high, or Insufficient information.
outputs.evidenceBody: Each factor shows the phrase that triggered it, with source and checked time when external checks run.
outputs.unknownsBody: Missing data stays unknown. You get practical steps to verify independently before you act.

paths.title: Start with the right check
paths.jobBody: Paste a description or scan a public post for warning signs.
paths.companyBody: Compare names, domains, and registration details against available sources.
paths.messageBody: Highlight pressure and payment requests across recruiter messages.
paths.recruiterBody: Review affiliation evidence, mismatches, and unknowns.

safety.title: Already paid or shared credentials?
safety.body: Contact the official cybercrime channels immediately. VERITORA does not recover money or investigate crimes.

principles.title: How VERITORA is different
principles.allegations: Community reports are user allegations pending moderation. There is no public blacklist.
principles.privacy: External text is treated as untrusted data, never as instructions.
principles.rules: Core checks work without an LLM; every external claim stores its source and checked time.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist, was moved, or the link is incomplete.

common.disclaimer: VERITORA is a decision-support tool. It does not provide legal findings or guarantees.

cyber.title: Report Cybercrime
cyber.notOfficial: VERITORA is not the official portal and does not file complaints on your behalf.
cyber.certinNote: CERT-In is an incident-response body and is not a replacement for a police or cybercrime complaint.

trustscan.title: TrustScan
trustscan.subtitle: One opportunity. Complete verification.
trustscan.description: Analyze job postings, verify company credibility and assess recruiter authenticity before taking your next career step.

trends.title: Trends & early warning
trends.subtitle: Weekly counts of moderator-approved community reports. Trends are signals for review, not findings.
trends.empty: No approved reports in this window yet.
trends.noRising: No category is rising week over week.
trends.loadError: Unable to load trend analytics. You may not have permission or the service is unavailable.
trends.forbidden: You do not have permission to view trend analytics.
trends.disclaimer: Counts include approved reports only and are not evidence of wrongdoing.

reports.loadError: Unable to load moderation queue. You may not have permission or the service is unavailable.

appeals.note: Appeals are submitted by report owners. Review the message and linked report, then take an appropriate moderation action on the report.

audit.title: Audit log review
audit.subtitle: Administrator-only review of recorded actions. Sensitive details and IPs are not shown.
audit.unavailable: Audit log review is not available in this build.
audit.forbidden: Audit log access is restricted to administrators.
audit.empty: No audit events found for the selected filters.

ratings.title: Rating review
ratings.unavailable: Rating review/duplicate-spam clustering endpoints are not available in this build.

passports.title: My Passports
passports.subtitle: Trust Passports are shareable, time-limited snapshots for decision support (not certificates). You can revoke an active passport at any time. Share links are shown only when created.
passports.empty: No passports yet. Create one from an analysis result to share a snapshot.
passports.noLink: For security, the share token/link is shown only once at creation time and is not stored in retrievable form.

auth.tagline: Verify opportunities. Detect deception. Protect job seekers.
